notes.title: HOTFIX PATCH NOTES 25 September
notes.notes:
Hey Operators,

Thanks for supporting Arena Breakout: Infinite! We want you to have a fun and enjoyable experience with the game, so we will be making some updates and adjustments to it. The specifics are detailed below.



Update Time:

Sep. 25, 2025 (UTC+0)

How to Update:

Live Update. If you are online during the update, you must exit the game, then click Update in the game's launcher to complete the update. 



Live Update. If you are online during the update, you must exit the game and then update the game in your Steam Library.



Updated Content:

Event Updates and Changes

1. Login Rewards

Event Time: Sep. 30 – Oct. 07 (UTC+0)

Check in daily to claim a wealth of rewards, including a Weapon Skin Voucher, Pet Voucher, Universal Keycard Chain, Advanced Quick Kit, and Premium Random Koen Bundle!

2. Twilight Embers Military Supply duration has been extended, with the end date adjusted to October 30, 2025.  



Fixes & Improvements

1. Added a starting limit for Lockdown Zone: 1,000,000 Koen Coins. If the value of the equipment exceeds the limit, the match cannot be initiated.  

2. Increased the scanning range of the Recon Terminal on the TV Station map, from scanning the 1st-floor area to scanning the 1st and 2nd-floor areas.  

3. Increased the basic stats of the MDR Integrated Handguard.

Vertical Recoil Control: 6 -> 7

Horizontal Recoil Control: 7 -> 11

4. Fixed the issue with incorrect selling prices for 3 types of cards in the Night City Defender event.

5. Fixed the display issue that occurs when returning to the Lobby from the shooting range after equipping the Banishing Blade.

6. Fixed the display issue with the Simple Red Dot Sight when the Twilight Embers skin is applied.

7. Fixed the issue on the Farm map where characters could get stuck in certain areas of the Stables.

8. Fixed the issue where the Highlights feature fails to activate automatically in Covert Ops mode.

9. Fixed the issue where the scanning sound effects from the Recon Terminal would persist after returning to the Lobby if a player extracted while the scanning screen remained active.

10. Fixed the issue where the Show Outfit button on the equipment screen would reset to a deactivated state after logging back into the game.

11. Fixed the issue where the quality of items in the Trophy Room's Badge Shelf was not displayed and adjusted the arrangement order  .

12. Fixed the issue that prompted players to purchase owned weapons when selecting a preset build.

13. Fixed the blurry text in tactical files.



Thanks again for your valuable feedback and suggestions!

Happy gaming!

The Arena Breakout: Infinite Team

Sep. 24, 2025 (UTC+0)

Hey there!Arena Breakout: Infinite Full Release is live on Steam now!

An updated Trophy Room; new infrastructure available for construction such as the Living Area, Intelligence Center, and Workbench; and an upgraded collectibles display to fully display your skills and luck!

Supply Stations have been added to all maps. Enjoy new strategic choices in raids!

 

Thanks for supporting Arena Breakout: Infinite!


Full Release Content PreviewAvailable Maps
Five maps will be available in Full Release: the Farm, Valley, Northridge, Armory, and TV Station.

 

Available Modes

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/ba92b692ad94e479ddd842d0a92d98fe2d74824a.jpg"]
Tactical Ops
Enter the Dark Zone as an operator with your own weapons, equipment, and items that are customized according to the operation's objective and your own assets.

Three difficulty levels will be available in Tactical Ops: Normal, Lockdown Zone, and Forbidden Zone.
Normal
A standard region with no requirements to enter. Everyone earns something here. Suitable for new operators in the Dark Zone.
Lockdown Zone
A dangerous Lockdown Zone rich in supplies. A ticket is required to enter, and you must also bring equipment totaling up to a certain value.

Suitable for experienced operators.
Forbidden Zone
A lethal Forbidden Zone replete with supplies. A more expensive ticket is required to enter, and you must also bring even pricier equipment.

Suitable only for the strongest operators.

 
Covert Ops
Enter the Dark Zone with random equipment. Play as a militant and search for remaining supplies on the battlefield without using any equipment from your Storage.

 
Solo Op
Enter the raid solo with the same equipment value and Koen cost as the conventional Lockdown Zone mode. Solo Op supports Rank Points.

 
Secure Ops
In Secure Ops, you won't lose any gear when you fail to extract. If you extract successfully, all the supplies you've gotten in the raid will be converted into Koen.

 
Team Elimination
No need to bring in any gear, select your set when the raid begins. Engage in round-based faction combat. The first faction to win 4 rounds wins.
 Team Deathmatch
You will be divided into two factions for the battle. Eliminated players will respawn immediately. The first team to reach the specified number of eliminations wins.

 
Arsenal Shuffle
When you are eliminated, your weapon will be replaced with a random one. The first faction to reach the required number of eliminations in the allotted time wins.

 
Arsenal
In Arsenal mode, each level corresponds to a different weapon. Your level increases by 1 for every 2 enemies eliminated, and your weapon will be replaced with a weapon that matches your new level. The first team to eliminate 1 enemy with a max level weapon is the winner.

FAQ
Q: Why am I unable to download the game?

A: Please ensure your device meets the minimum requirements listed above and has 70 GB of available storage space. We are continuously improving the game's performance and minimum requirements, and we sincerely apologize if you encounter this issue.

 

Q: How can I optimize the game's performance on my laptop?

A: You can change your laptop's GPU direct mode (see your laptop manufacturer's website for details) or play with your battery plugged in to improve performance.

 

Q: What should I do if I encounter bugs or issues while playing?

A: You can contact customer service via the methods listed below:

- In-Game: Submit your feedback via Settings -> Privacy -> Customer Service.



- Official Website: Reach out to our customer service via Support -> Contact Us on our official website (https://www.arenabreakoutinfinite.com/en).



Additionally, you can join our Discord community and submit your feedback to an official moderator.

 

Q: Can I use my official account on Steam?

A: A Level Infinite Pass account is required to log in to Arena Breakout: Infinite, so your account information can be used on multiple platforms and will be synced between them. Your account is not limited by platform.

 

Q: Is matchmaking available between players using Steam and official accounts?

A: Players from all platforms can join matchmaking and play together in Arena Breakout: Infinite.

 

Q: I've already downloaded Arena Breakout: Infinite. Do I need to download the game again to play it via Steam?

A: Yes, redownloading is required if you intend to launch the game via Steam.

 

Q: Are controllers supported?

A: Controllers are currently not supported.

 

Q: Does Arena Breakout: Infinite support Linux or the Steam Deck?

A: Linux and the Steam Deck are currently not supported.

 

Q: Can I choose which server to play on?

A: In the current version, you cannot select a specific server. The system will automatically assign players to the optimal server based on their IP address to ensure the lowest possible network latency.

 

Q: Which season is the game currently in? Will there be a wipe?

A: The full release version marks our Season 3 BREACH. Currently, there are no plans for a wipe.

 

Q: Which languages are supported?

A: The game supports multiple languages, including English, Chinese, German, Russian, Japanese, Portuguese, Spanish, and Thai. Support for additional languages will be added in future updates.

 

Q: What is Elite Privilege?

A: Elite Privilege is a membership system in the game that provides additional benefits, such as increased storage space, exclusive skins, and other in-game rewards. This privilege can typically be unlocked by purchasing a membership or completing specific tasks.

 

Q: How do I launch and log into the game on the Steam version?

A: You need to launch the game through Steam and log in using your Level Infinite Pass account.

 

Q: How do I link my game account to Steam?

A: After launching the game, log in to your existing LIP account via the Launcher.

 

Q: Will my playtime and achievements as an existing player be synced with Steam?

A: No, Steam achievements are not available at this time.

 

Q: What anti-cheat system does ABI use?

A: The game uses ACE (Anti-Cheat Engine) as its anti-cheat monitoring system. ACE is our core system for detecting, analyzing, and banning cheating activities, ensuring a fair and competitive environment for all players. For more information, please visit: Arena Breakout: Infinite - Introducing ACE: The Anti-Cheat System Behind Arena Breakout: Infinite - Steam News

 

Q: How do I report cheaters?

A: If you encounter players engaging in malicious behavior such as teamkilling, you can report them through the following methods:

After a match, click the \[Report] button on the match results screen.

Within 24 hours after a match, go to \[Personal Info] - \[Match History] on the top right of the main interface, and select \[Using Cheating Tools] to report.

Once a report is submitted, the system will review the reported player. If violations are confirmed, appropriate penalties will be applied.

 

Q: How do I report inappropriate nicknames or profile pictures?

A: If you encounter players with \[inappropriate profile pictures], you can report them through the following methods:

After a match, click the \[Report] button on the match results screen.

Go to \[Personal Info] - \[Match History] on the top right of the main interface, and select \[Posting Inappropriate Content] to report.

Click on the reported player’s \[Profile] - \[Report Player] to submit a report.

Once a report is submitted, the system will review the reported player. If violations are confirmed, appropriate penalties will be applied.



See you in Kamona!

 

The Arena Breakout: Infinite Team

Sep. 16, 2025 (UTC+0)

notes.title: Steam Full Release Dev Blog
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Arena Breakout: Infinite will officially launch its Full Release on September 15, alongside our long-awaited arrival on Steam.



We're very grateful to everyone who voiced your support and shared your feedback with us. We also want to welcome the new mercenaries who will soon join us through Steam.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/fdd6ee7dc988e78ac3701a2064b5693147e46107.png"]
Authentic Tactical Extraction FPS
Arena Breakout: Infinite is a FREE immersive tactical extraction FPS. From the Closed Beta in May 2024, to Early Access in August, and now to the upcoming Full Release, every step has been shaped by one core philosophy: authentic gunplay, distinct visual identity, intense combat immersion, and a fair competitive experience.

Every fix and update we’ve made has been built around this foundation.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/dc0d6064d1c6b93cf85960265745bf3f847b939d.png"]
Continuous Content Updates: In-Raid and Beyond
Arena Breakout: Infinite's full release comes with 5 maps that vary in size, theme, and environment; and in-raid mechanics such as a dynamic weather system, random extraction points, and supply stations. Every raid will be a brand-new experience!


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/aacc3ed2bdf058d4b1dbbc6544eca23c94e3f7eb.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/ae5734b0c70dd7776b70d5de0b5014776955e7c6.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/0b6dd0c07c995f728357729cdc317d6d7f6810f0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/ee2aac1372888398d00df787b0c76bb051f515c2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/57410910179a44d0f796a59d40498b1ea5f7ad9e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/f40ee57ddaae7142fb2ab34f4e5b60571cddb4ac.png"][/carousel]




We want to break players out of repetitive routines and reduce overreliance on fixed routes and loadouts.We're also striving to keep improving existing maps. For example, the Farm's expansion and the increased amount of cover in maps to provide more tactical choices and tools for collecting information.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/71f3e4feff29e14c13dff81bf4a7c8d1a2ba1ce7.png"]

Arena Breakout: Infinite offers modes for every type of player. If you're searching for intense and thrilling raids, Lockdown Zone and Forbidden Zone are the modes for you. If playing solo is your thing, SOLO OP is perfect. As for new recruits in Kamona or players who seek a relaxed experience, you can choose from multiple modes such as Secure Ops, Team Deathmatch, and Team Elimination.

In short, Kamona always has a survival way for you!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/54ade71f2dcbf9f7fab10205c9674a7f1dfd94d7.png"]

In the Full Release, the Trophy Room has been fully expanded. Beyond displaying your collection, it now features functional modules that let you strengthen yourself outside of raids and make better use of the miscellaneous items in your Storage.

 

Balance issues related to growth outside of raids are another area we're constantly monitoring, so you'll still get to enjoy fair competition against long-time players. The Trophy Room will continue to receive new content and iterations in future updates, and we encourage you to share your feedback with us!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/6061ef3550157b3239e5a5fa9ace64346c777ddf.png"]
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/61de7d86d57da72e696ac69928f8a0084c634beb.png"][/carousel]QoL Updates, Smoother and More Enjoyable Experience


There are also some quality of life updates that will improve your experience of the game. Many of them come from players in our community. From lobby auto-heal and auto-storage for valuable loot, to kill cam, real-time item value display, and loot priority function—these QoL upgrades are here to make every raid smoother and smarter.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/2dc00c9c6ae47c89d05d02dda9f116e721dd25d5.gif"]



In the Full Release, we’ve made several improvements to matchmaking efficiency and UI. More quality-of-life changes have been implemented, like you'll be able to link keychains to maps, so once you enter a given map, your keychain will switch automatically. The ability to cancel lockpicking actions; and many other updates, including a new memory feature for Storage organization, squad communication channels, spectating/death replay systems, and more.




Commitment to Fair Play
Since the launch of Early Access, the purchasing Koen system has served as a part of the in-game economy, designed to support a specific stage of the game’s development. As the game evolved across multiple versions, we saw Operators gaining access to more diverse and rewarding ways to earn Koen. In its early phase, the purchasing Koen system offered some players a fast track to restart and recover — a purpose it has now fulfilled. Therefore, with the Full Release, we have decided to officially bring it to an end, shifting our focus entirely toward more diverse, fair, and rewarding ways for players to earn resources.

 

Red ammo and high-level armor are a recurring subject of discussion in our communities, and we have been following it since the beginning. In past updates, we've tried adjusting and balancing their stats in an attempt to resolve the issues. However, the data showed that some items still remained overly dominant. So we decided to place stricter limits on the production of these OP items. Some high-level items will no longer be available to trade in the Market—you'll only be able to get them by crafting them at the Workbench of Trophy Room.



We've consistently implemented multiple balance adjustments in the previous seasons. For example, we've implemented an array of restrictive measures to balance the advantages inherent in some equipment and tools that exceeded our expectations, such as the T7 Thermal Imager, throwables that do damage. These adjustments give players more diverse choices, ensuring that every combination of weapons, gear, and tactics can play a meaningful role in each raid. Our attention will remain on balance issues throughout future updates to ensure raids remain fair.

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/bdb69571f43272797a43f067304da02a5c5066d4.png"]

In terms of anti-cheating, we maintain a zero tolerance policy toward all cheating, and we are constantly improving our detection system and will impose strict bans on all cheaters. For players who fall victim to cheaters, we not only compensate the value of lost gear in in-game currency, but also provide an additional “comfort payout.” Our efforts are aimed at maintaining a positive and fair in-game environment for our community.

 

That’s all for this Dev Blog. The Full Release is almost here, and we’ll see you in Kamona! If you want to get game updates and official guides from us, don't forget to follow us on social media!

notes.title: From Beta to Future, Arena Breakout: Infinite Community Update
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The round of test for "Arena Breakout: Infinite" has now concluded, and the servers have officially shut down. As this was an exclusive beta trial, all associated game data is scheduled for deletion within the coming 30 business days. 

Ever since we released the first official announcement on STEAM, our game has garnered over 1 million on our Wishlist. We're very thankful to our vibrant community for your constant support and the suggestions that have helped us fine-tune and elevate our game. Your enthusiasm and input are the driving forces behind our continuous improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44984203/2b31b72ea1710b5553af360a4b843cb3d063c781.jpg

Seizing this moment, we would like to share our upcoming plans and address the concerns that are frequently on the minds of our players. 

Q1: Further Update Plans and Launch Milestones 

We've been thrilled by the enthusiastic response and the flood of questions from our players. Your energy and support are greatly appreciated. Our team is fully dedicated to refining the game based on feedback from our test and is actively expanding the game with fresh experiences, including the introduction of new weapons, new maps, and continuous improvement of the QOL systems.
We're working hard to ensure that these updates are released for your enjoyment at the earliest opportunity. For further information, please visit our official social channels and stay connected for updates you won't want to miss!

Q2: About Game Fairness and Subsequent Anti-Cheat Measures

ABI maintains a strict stance against any breaches of in-game rules and activities that compromise the game's integrity. To date, we have established a robust anti-cheat framework encompassing these four key strategies:

1.	Enhanced endpoint protection: Encrypted user-end code/data to increase the level of protection against hacking, debugging, and tampering.
2.	Cheating tool sample detection: ACE collects cheating tool samples, tests and analyzes them, identifies their characteristics, and enforces block penalties.
3.	Replay automated analysis and manual review: ACE analyzes replay data, restores in-game scenes and operation, uses deep learning models for intelligent analysis, identifies suspicious cheating users for manual review, detects cheating users, and enforces bans.
4.	DMA unauthorized equipment specialized testing: ACE collects DMA-related device information, tests and analyzes device characteristics, builds an unauthorized device library, evaluates user gaming behavior and replay data, identifies cheating users, and applies block penalties.

In the upcoming versions, we will continue to refine our plans and add new features to enhance the experience and improve the gaming environment:

1.	New feature: Kill-Cam.
2.	ACE's memory encryption solution will protect game memory data from DMA cheating tools.
3.	Machine blocking function for blocking malicious users' equipment.

Q3: About Monetization Systems

There has been quite a bit of discussion among the community about whether "ABI's business model will be Pay-to-Win (P2W)".
ABI operates on a Free-to-Play (F2P) model, aiming to keep the doors wide open for all players. Our in-game purchases focus on offering convenience and personalized customization, steering clear of a Pay-to-Win approach. Whether you pay for it or not, being part of our player base is a big nod of approval to us, and we're truly grateful for it.


In ABI, the balance of combat, the sharpness of your wits, and the importance of your operations truly matter, and these cannot be bought or influenced by payment. Koens, Weapon, Gear, Medical supplies, and other combat essentials are not restricted to those who pay—you can obtain them by trading, looting, taking down enemies, and completing missions.

ABI represents the first PC product from Morefun Studios in many years, after over three years in development. We are expecting great things with this game and are fully committed to it—listening to your feedback, considering every detail, implementing changes, and growing with each step. Your voice matters to us, and we are eternally grateful to all who have joined us in playing our game and being part of our community.

See you in the Dark Zone soon,
Arena Breakout: Infinite Team
